title: R0.4 Golden Relationship — House Memory and Advisor Today

evidence.domain: packages/domain/src/advisor/ — opportunity/clienteling domain logic; customer relationship and house memory core concept definitions
evidence.persistence: supabase/migrations/ — customer_facts, clienteling_opportunities, and associated RLS enforcement tables; supabase/tests/roadmap_approval_rls_test.sql for advisor/opportunity data access control
evidence.service: apps/retailer/app/(dashboard)/staff/today/actions.ts — complete opportunity action; apps/retailer/app/(dashboard)/customers/[id]/fact-correction-actions.ts — house memory fact correction and provenance tracking; packages/database/src/repositories/customer-repository.ts, customer-fact-repository.ts, and clienteling-opportunity-repository.ts — advisor/customer data retrieval with RLS enforcement
evidence.origin_ui: apps/retailer/app/(dashboard)/staff/today/page.tsx — My Day surface showing assigned opportunities with why-now context; apps/retailer/app/(dashboard)/staff/today/assigned-opportunity-list.tsx — opportunity list card rendering with click-through to House Memory
evidence.receiver_ui: apps/retailer/app/(dashboard)/customers/[id]/self-portrait.tsx — House Memory view displaying customer facts with provenance class (advisor_observed, customer_declared, etc) and fact type labels; shows evidence/why-now narrative; responsive to opportunity completion state changes
evidence.rls: supabase/tests/roadmap_approval_rls_test.sql — pgTAP test suite verifies advisor can only see customers they have opportunities assigned to; different advisors cannot see each other's assigned customers; completed opportunities are no longer visible to either advisor; customer_declared facts visible to all advisors for that retailer/customer pair
evidence.exceptions: RLS policy enforcement: advisor without an assignment to a specific customer cannot query that customer's record via the API; completed opportunities are filtered from future queries; invalid staff IDs (without accepted_at) cannot set passwords or access the Today surface
evidence.browser: apps/retailer/e2e/house-memory-advisor-today.spec.ts — authenticated E2E Advisor persona (owner + dynamically-created staff) against local Supabase; 3/3 passed at gitSha 2c4a627 (docs/evidence/runs/R0.4.json). Tests verify: (1) advisor navigates Today → House Memory → sees customer name + facts with provenance labels (Navy blue / Advisor observed, Business events / Declared) → completes opportunity → sees it removed from Today on refresh, (2) advisor A sees their assigned opportunity, advisor B does not (permission isolation), (3) House Memory renders stale evidence (facts observed 30+ days ago) and shows them with their age metadata; zero console/page errors across all tests
